desc: Parse `H`, `W`, and read the `H` row strings; convert each row to an integer bitmask and build a frequency array `f` of length `2^W`.
Build the array `g` where `g[x] = min(popcount(x), W - popcount(x))` for all `x` in `[0, 2^W)`.
Implement the Fast Walsh-Hadamard Transform (FWHT) for XOR convolution; apply it in-place to both `f` and `g`, then pointwise multiply the two transformed arrays.
Apply the inverse FWHT to the product array and divide every element by `2^W` to obtain the convolution result `h`.
Compute the minimum value in `h` and print it to stdout.
Test the solution with the provided sample inputs (1, 2, 3) and edge cases to verify correctness.
